name: zalo-lite-root
description: Root package for running microservices individually

scripts.build:all: npm run build:gateway && npm run build:user && npm run build:chat && npm run build:chatbot && npm run build:ai-worker && npm run build:frontend && npm run build:post
scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix backend/api-gateway && npm install --prefix backend/services/user-service && npm install --prefix backend/services/chat-service && npm install --prefix backend/services/chatbot-service && npm install --prefix backend/services/ai-worker-service && npm install --prefix frontend/web && npm install --prefix backend/services/post-service
scripts.start:all: concurrently "npm run start:gateway" "npm run start:user" "npm run start:chat" "npm run start:chatbot" "npm run start:ai-worker" "npm run start:frontend" "npm run start:post"
scripts.pm2:start: npm run build:all && pm2 start ecosystem.config.js
scripts.pm2:restart: npm run build:all && pm2 restart ecosystem.config.js
scripts.pm2:stop: pm2 stop ecosystem.config.js && pm2 delete ecosystem.config.js
